instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium-wide shot, eye-level. The woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right, facing left. They stand facing each other, clasping raised hands with elbows bent. Bright overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the dominant red carpet.
